name: pulse-music-workspace
description: Pulse music workspace web and Android application

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && node scripts/install-native-android.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && cap add android && node scripts/install-native-android.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:add && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
